title: Redis
description:
Redis: one command per panel, replies turned into rows. Needs `make it-up` (port
16379; 16380 with TLS). See `:help dbdash-databases`.

show.title: Keys (DBSIZE)
show.description: `DBSIZE`: the number of keys, as a stat.

query.transform:
-- INFO gives rows of { section, key, value }: keep a few, as numbers.
local keep = { used_memory = true, used_memory_peak = true, used_memory_rss = true }
local out = {}
for _, r in ipairs(rs.rows) do
  if keep[r[2]] then out[#out + 1] = { metric = r[2], bytes = tonumber(r[3]) } end
end
return out

show.title: Memory (INFO memory)
show.description:
`INFO memory` gives section / key / value rows; `query.transform` keeps three of them
